name: Akumakko to 3tsu no Onegai.
original_name: アクマっ娘と３つのお願い。
source:
As part of her demonic training a devil girl named Bell walks the earth to grant three wishes.
She lives with Hiroto while he mulls over his decision. What will he ask for? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088344.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
作为恶魔训练的一部分，名为贝尔的恶魔少女来到人间，实现三个愿望。
她与弘人同住，等待他考虑自己的决定。他会许下什么愿望？

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088344.html]DLSite English[/url]]
